verdict.rationale: Raygun's own marketing says it connects to repositories through native GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab integrations, which covers the repo-connection part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows what that connection delivers on an issue: no suspect commits, no code owners, and no linking from a stack frame to a source line on the default branch. missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution, code-owner assignment, stack-frame-to-source-line linking on the default branch, in-depth first-party docs on the repo integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform connects to my repos so an issue shows suspect commits and code owners, and I can jump from a stack frame to the exact line on my default branch

citations.quote: Connect to your repo through native integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab
